lina: heads up CI flagged multiple broken internal anchors after yesterday's migration batch. failing link is /quickstart#python-quickstart -> 404. samir: saw that too. looks like mkdocs slugifier lowercases and drops punctuation differently than the old docusaurus output. two headings generated identical slugs: 'quickstart-python' for both 'Python Quickstart' and 'Python Quickstart (legacy)'. collision. :face_with_raised_eyebrow: anne: I noticed the same when I previewed the site locally. the sidebar navigation also jumps to the wrong anchor for the legacy example. lina: is the legacy example important to keep? or can we rename the heading to 'Python Quickstart (v1)'? samir: renaming is fine, but there are external docs links that use the old fragment. prefer to keep compatibility by adding an explicit anchor for the legacy slug. example patch: ```html

Python Quickstart

``` tj: prefer the explicit id approach. also suggest adding a short redirect entry in the mkdocs-redirects plugin config for any renamed pages. avoids surprises for customers. lina: agree. can someone open a small PR doing: 1) explicit anchors for colliding headings, 2) update internal links to canonical ids, 3) add redirect entries for two renamed pages, 4) normalize code fence languages (py -> python) samir: i'll take it. planning to target docs/quickstart/python.md and docs/quickstart/legacy-python.md. will split into two commits so changelog is clear. anne: while you are in there, mind fixing the tiny markdownlint errors? the CI log shows `MD013` line-length warnings on a couple example commands. samir: will fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4982 -- includes commit messages and notes about preserving legacy anchors. docsbot: automated checks started for PR 4982: linkcheck, markdownlint, accessibility. ci-bot: linkcheck report: ERROR: /quickstart/python#Python.Quickstart -> anchor not found WARNING: /quickstart/python -> heading collision: python-quickstart repeated samir: added manual unit in the repo that runs `mkdocs build && mkdocs-linkcheck` locally; pasted failing lines into PR. tj: can you also add a tiny paragraph to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md under "anchors" with the pattern to preserve old fragments? saves future churn. samir: added CONTRIBUTING.md blurb in the PR: shows HTML anchor fallback and the double-anchor pattern. lina: netlify preview when ready? we should click through the quickstart TOC and validate sidebar links. samir: preview started: https://deploy-preview-99001--docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstart/python docsbot: Netlify build 99001 queued for branch docs/quickstart-anchor-fix ci-bot: automated checks: linkcheck PASS, markdownlint PASS, accessibility WARN (table contrast on quickstart examples) anne: i clicked the preview: both fragments resolve now, sidebar behaves. thanks. :raised_hands: tj: the accessibility warning is not blocking but please open an issue for the contrast fix. lina: filed issue #1310 for example table contrast and linked it in the PR description. samir: merged main after 2x LGTM. will follow up with small PR to adjust redirects plugin config in infra repo. anne: great work team. closing thread. :wave:
